title: —Did they hurt you much? Nasty Roche asked.
html_source:
Notice how “Nasty Roche” cares at all here whether Stephen was hurt much.

Earlier, Nasty Roche pushed Stephen into a cold slimy ditch and didn’t seem too concerned until Stephen became sick.

They are all still young enough to not be entirely certain of proper expectation/conduct, which is shown here, as Nasty Roche cares whether Stephen was hurt much, but pushed him into a ditch earlier.
